messages:
sarah: FYI eu1 canary for model-serve v3.2.1 failed immediately. build logs show missing symbol in libfastkv after a package bump in the eu1 image pipeline. Asking for a quick pin and skip of eu1 canary.

deploy-bot: Canary start: model-serve:v3.2.1 -> eu1 (10%)
Status: FAILED
Log snippet: ERROR: undefined symbol 'syncKV' in libfastkv.so -> dlopen failed

ops_kim: Do other regions show the issue?
sarah: us-west + staging OK. eu1 uses a different mirror and image build job; mirror got the bumped package yesterday.

ng_sre: Impact: ~4% error spike on kv paths in eu1 canary. No SLA breach. Recommendation: pin eu1 to model-serve:v3.2.0-eu1-frozen (validated last week) and hold rollout. Rollback: immediate revert to v3.2.0 if pin unstable.

alex_release: This is outside change window; requesting expedited approvals. Please respond +1 / -1 with scope and rollback criteria.

sarah: Proposed commands: kubectl -n prod set image ds/model-serve model-serve=model-serve:v3.2.0-eu1-frozen --context=eu1; deployctl pause rollout --service model-serve --regions eu1. Smoke watch 30m.

ops_kim: +1 from ops if exact commands used and alert added: eu1.modelserve.5xx > 0.01 for 10m -> page. Rollback trigger: sustained 5xx >1% for 10m.

ng_sre: +1 from SRE on-call, will monitor and ready to revert.

alex_release: +1 release lead, expedite approved for eu1-only; postmortem required and release notes updated.

sarah: Applying pin now; will paste rollout output.
deploy-bot: set image applied on eu1 daemonset. Rollout: 2/2 updated, 0 unavailable.
sarah: Quick smoke: /health 200, sample inference OK, first batch queued.

ng_sre: Monitoring for 30m. If stable, schedule rebuild of eu1 image without the bad package.
sarah: 30m passed, no sustained errors. Leaving temporary alert for 24h. Opening postmortem ticket with logs and mirror timestamps.
alex_release: Decision recorded: scope=eu1-only, mitigation=pin-image, postmortem=required, state=resolved. :white_check_mark:

sarah: Thanks all, will follow up in the postmortem.
